text: Not applicable to today's text-only stories, and safety-relevant when illustrations arrive: information carried only by the picture escapes the text validators (banned phrases, ceiling, safety topics). 'What is hiding' drawn but not written is exactly the kind of content a parent's avoided topics or 'Sakin' level cannot filter. Also, read-aloud (MPSpeech) and VoiceOver users lose picture-only facts, so a story must still be complete in text.
